text:
maya: Quick note — we have a copy drift between Console, Quickstart docs panel, and SDK snippets. Console shows 'slot group' on the deployments list, quickstart panel uses 'pool', and SDK examples say 'deployment lane'. New users stumble on the checklist. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/term-drift-4.png sam: Thanks for flagging. Is this purely copy or are there UX differences? maya: Purely copy. All three refer to the same concept. erin: I'd like to pick one user-facing term. Suggestion: 'serving slot' — short, maps well to both UI and docs. chad: Engineering note: backend metrics and endpoints currently use slot_group.* as keys. We can leave backend keys, but surface 'serving slot' in UI/docs and add metric aliases. maya: Docs microcopy proposal for the Quickstart panel: ```html

Serving slot (aka slot group / pool / deployment lane)

Serving slots represent a named set of replicas used for routing and scaling. See Serving slots for routing, quotas, and billing.

``` This keeps the primary term prominent and shows mappings inline for discoverability (no hover-only content). erin: Accessibility: ensure the parenthetical mapping is in the DOM and that the info button has aria-describedby referencing the mapping. Don't rely on tooltip-only content — mobile and keyboard users need visible text. a11y-bot: Note: screen-reader check currently fails when the quickstart header uses nested small tags. Prefer explicit aria-label that contains the full phrase. Example: aria-label="Quickstart: Serving slot (formerly: slot group / pool / deployment lane)" chad: Telemetry plan: we'll add alias metrics serving_slot.* mapped to slot_group.* for 90 days and add migration notes on the metrics dashboard. Will also add short redirects for old doc slugs. docs-bot: Created DOCS-7220 (glossary + redirects) and UX-5198 (panel microcopy). @erin assigned for copy review. sam: QA asks: add a visual regression test that checks the quickstart panel header at 320px width to prevent truncation, and an accessibility unit test asserting aria-label contains the parenthetical mapping. erin: I'll update the mock and post accessible markup in UX-5198. Also adding the small in-panel glossary line so keyboard users don't miss it. maya: Rollout plan: docs and quickstart copy update next week behind FF; Console copy change behind a gradual rollout; telemetry alias on deploy day. We'll keep slot_group.* metrics live for 90 days. chad: I'll open the telemetry PR after DOCS-7220 lands. Sam, can QA add the narrow-width snapshot and the aria assertion? sam: Yup, will add tests and link to UX-5198. maya: Great. Closing after UX-5198 and DOCS-7220 are merged. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
